title: heap-use-after-free of system_bazelrc_path

labels.name: team-Configurability
labels.description: platforms, toolchains, cquery, select(), config transitions

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Running `//src/test/cpp:rc_file_test` on mac with ASAN enabled finds error.
This was introduced in bccf9c63ff0863e3ffb4fb24085a37a03db10aaa.
cc: @cvcal 

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

`bazel test //src/test/cpp:rc_file_test --copt="-fsanitize=address" --linkopt="-fsanitize=address"`

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

macOS 10.13.6 (17G65)

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

HEAD

### What's the output of `git remote get-url origin ; git rev-parse master ; git rev-parse HEAD` ?

https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel.git
c8e679617c425ad4ac5901bc2c80273e3dcf6dc2
